candidates.name: WavPack high/very-high with extra processing
candidates.evidence: Established audio-codec benchmark leader family; current docs explain high/extra modes and throughput tradeoffs. Our WavPack 5.8 very-high pin remains a credible reference, not a universal optimum.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: FLAC
candidates.evidence: The original 16-recording benchmark includes audio alternative; needs exact full-channel and framing accounting on short chunks.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: Blosc/Zstd with reversible time/space delta
candidates.evidence: The author benchmark systematically varies delta filters and compression/chunk settings; current local delta-blosc reference is only one setting.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: LZMA/Zstd lossless with predictors
candidates.evidence: Generic strong lossless families, exact short-block overhead can alter size ordering.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference: WavPack 5.8 lossless very-high; delta + Blosc/Zstd level 9; raw zlib level 9
current_reference_limitations: Only 4,096 samples × 384 channels per record, approximately 0.137 seconds.
The original paper’s 0.1/1/10-second chunk and LSB/preprocessing choices do not transfer automatically.
Lossy hybrid modes are ineligible for byte-exact B07 even if sorting is unchanged.
Codec size, throughput and decode compatibility tradeoffs preclude blanket tool replacement.
recommended_next_comparator: Retain WavPack; add pinned FLAC and current WavPack high/extra levels plus reversible time/space delta-Zstd with predeclared budget. Count all headers/metadata and decode every one of the 16 chunks byte exactly; repeat longer chunks before storage policy recommendation.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
